newsitem.title: UK: BIOTECHNOLOGY PLANS SHARE BUY BACK.
newsitem.headline: BIOTECHNOLOGY PLANS SHARE BUY BACK.

text.p: Biotechnology Investments Ltd said on Friday that it was concerned that its share price does not fully relect the true value of the company and announced plans to buy back up to 15 percent of its issued shares.

"In order to enhance shareholder value the company proposes to take advantage of the discount at which its shares are trading by purchasing shares at a price of less that NAV," said the firm in a statement.
It said that the company will seek shareholder approval to buy back shares at or close to the market price, and added that the purchase would assist liquidity and increase NAV per share.
Biotechnology also announced annual results which showed that net assets per share for the year to May 31, 1997, was 7.12 dollars compared with 6.53 previously.
